name: saanpaw
description: SaanPaw capstone monorepo (mobile + backend + design docs).

scripts.build: npm run build:console && npm run build:mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace shared run typecheck && npm --workspace mobile run typecheck && npm --workspace web run typecheck

//overrides: Several packages accept wide peer ranges, so npm hoists a newer release to the repo root while the workspace pins the Expo SDK 54 version. Metro then resolves the hoisted copy and fails on changed package exports. expo-font is here because @expo/vector-icons floats to 15.1.x, which wants expo-font 57 while SDK 54 ships 14 - two copies of a native module breaks Android builds. Pinning keeps exactly one of each in the tree.
